---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Gable
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Describe the real-world lumber & building-materials
(LBM) operations pain point, or the gap in the current behavior. "I'm always
frustrated when..." is a great start.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Affected area

Which component would this touch? (e.g. a backend module under
`backend/internal/`, an installable app under `backend/pkg/apps/`, a frontend
surface in `app/`). See `LICENSE-MAP.md` for the component map.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer the proposal.

## Scope & compatibility

- Does this require a database migration or schema change?
- Does it affect the public API surface (`/api/v1`, `/api/portal/v1`,
  `/api/integration`, `/api/v1/a2a`)?
- Any backward-compatibility concerns?

## Additional context

Mockups, references to how legacy LBM systems handle this, links to related
issues, or anything else that helps.
